scopeNotes: apps/web/src/features/auth/client.ts and apps/web/src/features/auth/pages.tsx were modified under the task's explicit integration exception to carry the verified provider OTP/session handoff in memory and route the provider account flow.
The current runtime has no public location/service-area lookup route. The UI reports the missing location fields truthfully and does not fabricate identifiers or endpoints.

The approved AUTH-09 reference includes password/contact-preference controls that are not present in the current provider contract. The implementation preserves the current phone-OTP authority and does not invent unsupported fields.
Playwright API responses are intercepted only inside tests; no Production mock or fallback data was added.
knownGaps: The repository declares Node >=24 <25 while this environment is Node v22.18.0; all mandatory checks passed under the available runtime.
The provider application remains incomplete until the existing backend supplies primary location and service-area selection behavior in a later approved scope.
